name: preloader
title: Preloader
summary: Full-screen loader shown while the page loads and while the frontend translation runs.
description: Rendered by page_constructor at the start of <body>; an inline head script (assets/js/preloader_init.js, value part "head") adds html.is-loading before the first paint, so without JavaScript the loader never shows. It hides when the page is ready (window load, or DOMContentLoaded with "wait": "dom") and, when i18n_frontend is translating, only after the dm:i18n-done event. A safety limit (max_ms) always hides it. Other scripts can use window.dmPreloader.show(key) / hide(key); the language switcher shows it when a language is chosen. Options in data_settings_site.json: "preloader": { "enabled": true, "wait": "load" | "dom", "max_ms": 4000 } or "preloader": false.
